notes.title: Game update announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support for the game!
This update includes the following contents:
1. The game can eat and drink now

Hello, friends,
I'm woodpeck, trying to be an independent game producer,
Just now a friend asked me what happened to Mr. Fu's kidney,
What did I say?
Send me a screenshot, I have a look!
Oh, it was
My first game is on sale.
It's not very good, but people have put forward a lot of very good opinions to me,
You don't make random comments. Your ideas are clear. I have beer and I have everyone's support
In the future, we will produce better and better quality games. I will also give you Kangkang my game development progress on a regular basis.
Preview, the next game is card game, I will prepare well.
Salute you, salt!
